```{r}
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
con <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "me315.sqlite")
```

## Questão 1
```{sql connection=con}
select state, min(acres) as menor_area
from preserve
group by state

```

## Questão 2
```{sql connection=con}
select state, max(acres) maior_area
from preserve
where acres <= 10000
group by state

```

## Questão 3
```{sql connection=con}
select state, max(acres) maior_area
from preserve
where acres <= 10000
group by state
order by maior_area desc
```

## Questão 4
```{sql connection=con}
select state, max(acres) as maior_area
from preserve
group by state
having maior_area < 25000
```

## Questão 5
```{sql connection=con}
select state, min(acres) as menor_area
from preserve
group by state
having menor_area < 100
```

## Questão 6
```{sql connection=con}
select state, pname, max(acres) as maior_area
from preserve
where acres > 1000
group by state
having maior_area < 25000
```

## Questão 7
```{sql connection=con}
select state, sum(acres) as tamanho_total
from preserve
group by state
having tamanho_total between 10000 and 50000
```

## Questão 8
```{sql connection=con}
select state, avg(acres) as qtd_media
from preserve
group by state
order by qtd_media desc
limit 1
```

## Questão 9
```{sql connection=con}
select dno, avg(salary) as salario_medio
from employee
group by dno
```

## Questão 10
```{sql connection=con}
select dno, sum(salary) as total_salario, max(salary) as salario_maximo, min(salary) as salario_minimo
from employee
group by dno
```

## Questão 11
```{sql connection=con}
select dno, count(*) as qtd_func
from employee
where not dno=40
group by dno
```

## Questão 12
```{sql connection=con}
select dno, count(*) as qtd_func
from employee
group by dno
having qtd_func >2
```

## Questão 13
```{sql connection=con}
select state, sum(acres)
from preserve
group by state

union all
select 'Total' as state, sum(acres) as 'sum(acres)'
from preserve
```
